requirement_text: Please check carefully the category below you identify with, as it will affect the application process. EU and EU-equated citizens / Non-EU citizens residing outside Italy: Citizens of any country outside the European Union, Iceland, Lichtenstein, Norway, Switzerland or San Marino AND who do not have a double nationality, including Italian or any European nationality, AND who cannot be considered as non-EU citizens residing in Italy.
researcher_notes: A more precisely worded citizenship-category definition than seen at other Italian institutions this pass -- explicitly excludes dual nationals (including Italian/any European nationality) from the 'non-EU citizen' category, and separately excludes non-EU citizens who are themselves already resident in Italy (a third, intermediate category, treated differently in the timeline below).

requirement_text: Candidates must register for the IMAT on the Universitaly portal, around June/July; the procedure to follow is available on the portal. Information concerning application dates, application procedure and test dates will be available in the Call for admission, which is published each year around June/July.
researcher_notes: Directly confirms the brief's specific IMAT point for English-taught Medicine: IMAT registration happens through the Universitaly portal itself (the same portal used for the visa/quota pre-enrolment process at other Italian institutions researched this pass), around June/July annually. Padua's own page defers exact dates entirely to the yearly published Call for Admission rather than stating them here -- a genuine, sourced 'not published on this general page' finding, not a research gap.
